datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Afghanistan in 2019, classifying geographic units by food insecurity phase. The data represents post-assessment impact classifications reflecting drought and food security crisis conditions.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerations across Afghanistan, classifying populations by acute food insecurity severity
